tiv_text: Bagu gema tuhwa wan na er ‘inyéndu’

deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh or. ne u vendan imbwase i kaan

tiv_text: Avange u pirinashe yô Aôndo koson un iyolna.
english_translation: It is God who feeds a blind lizard.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne sha u tesen ishima i wan sha akaa. Tese er ka we a amber sha akaa ga u va zua a kwagh. Or u a lu a iniôngon iyol ga kpaa gbenda u waren ka u lu.

tiv_text: TingeBagu tse ku ka myenge.
english_translation: An old monkey lives long because of its watchfulness.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne sha u tesen mlu u tsevtsev man sulaa sha hanma kwagh. Ka u wan ityogh eren akaa a u henen sha mi ga.

tiv_text: Ivaan i í ker sha ada ú mimi ga, ngi te kwagh ga, ka i hide i tume zwa inya.

deeper_meaning: Tiv mba hembe õron injakwagh ne shie u ve lu wan wan kwagh sha inyaregh ki zuan a mi sha mimi ga yõ. Ka ve tese er, kwagh u zuan a mi sha mimi ga ka a za gwa kpishi kpa a lu gbem ga, shi m kur na a doo ga.

tiv_text: Ka we a mende akuzwa u kera fehen usu ga.
english_translation: Once you have a moustache, you no longer blow on the fire.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne sha u vendan iyongo i hiin. Ka ve tese er se kpa se mar ônov nahan se de kera hiin iyongo ga. Shin se penda kor yongo yô ia lu sha ityogh ki mbayev asev. Paregh kwagh u vihin sha er u va lu a mzeyol ga yô.

tiv_text: Akuzwa doon hodon iombor ga, ka i mir an-mnger keng.
english_translation: A moustache is not good to be shaved when it is dry; wet it first.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er naagh ku de yinan we ga. U nan ga la hemba vihin. Voogh er u kende an-mnger sha ice i sha zwa ga u kember a nyoon we nahan.

tiv_text: Avange u a undu Haa yô, kera ngu wanye ga. Tiv mba soon u tesen ken injakwagh ne er, we a lu cuku kpa ityő a kende a we sha yõ ieren you i de tesen yev ga. Tor u ityo you i neu la we u tsev a kua ken shima.
english_translation: A lizard that climbs a mahogany tree is no longer a baby.

tiv_text: Ayôôso a ken kasua nga yangen ivyo ngeren ga. Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er mjirim ma yangen tom ga. Mzeyol shin mbamtaver ve de yangen we kwagh u u soo u eren ga.
english_translation: The noise in the market square does not stop a goat from drinking water.

tiv_text: Mba Aõndo A kende ve tsar yô, ve a vihi vanger sha mboho ga kpa ve a per.
english_translation: Those for whom God has made a bridge do not crawl across Gardenia erubescens.
deeper_meaning: Ibohogh ka kon u ka u nongo u lun hen kpe uaghee yô. Ka ki nôngo u nguran kpishi nahan ashie gbing ka i kôr wegh sha mi i per uagh zum u tsar u lu ga yô. Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u pasen er mba Aôndo a ne ve ikyôr yô ve a ya ican keng man ve a zua a kwagh ga.

tiv_text: Anyigôr u atem ya ken Mngishi vaan ijen ga. Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er anye u alu ya sha agbur tolugh ga. Tese er u ngu ken ato u kwagh nahan kwagh un a ban u ga.
english_translation: A worm that builds its home inside a garden egg never cries from hunger.

tiv_text: Aôndo u a hee u kpesa la un a nau akuur a aan.
english_translation: The God who gives you an itch will also give you fingernails to scratch it.
deeper_meaning: Kpesa ka avav a cuku-cuku. Ka a agher kpishi. Tiv mba er kwagh on tesen er Aondo un a nau ican yô, un a hide at a gbenda u wasen we ican shon, shin yiman we.

tiv_text: Anjande ú ágbeityő a nyer ken kungô ifi lun a akambe tseegh ga anshuuv kpa ka ve lu. Tiv mba er kwagh ne, u tesen er kwagh banen wan shin anngbyan u Tor ga. Or u nan we ndor a ornyar cii kwagh un a ban nan ga.
english_translation: A stream that flows into a river has not only crabs but fish as well.

tiv_text: Mba wuese nguhar môm mtum ga. Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er mba er ijir vegher mõm ga. Avegher la cii ka a tema her i ungwa akaaõron a ve cii.

tiv_text: Tse-ihyundu kera keren awen ga, ka a kohol a kohol awen.
english_translation: A man who has been mad for a long time no longer throws stones; instead, he gathers them.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u pasen er ka we a va hingir orya shin organden u kera hiin iyongo ga, ka u waan a wa kwagh, shin u sôron a sôr tar.

tiv_text: Úmenden anyi a kôkônan ka kwagh u bo ga, ka u lun a akuzwa ú cilin ga la, i lu iyongo ú lu hiin ior ye.
english_translation: Having long teeth is not the problem; the problem is not having enough lips to cover them.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er kwagh ne sha u pasen er we a lu a agee a maren mbayev kpishi yô, shi u lu a agee a koson ve. Shi we a fa wer u wa kwagh ave u un a va gande u yô, guda we u de hiin ga.

tiv_text: Iywa i ilu i ape fan ikyōr yö, i keghen hondo ga. Ka a gbilen gbuuka sha avande tsô maa i lu sha gbenda.
english_translation: A dog that wants to become a great hunter does not wait for the hunter's whistle. The moment the hunter shoulders his gun, the dog follows.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u pasen er or u nan lu a kwaghfan u marami nan keghen er i wa a wa nan kwagh man nan a er ga, ka nan a nengen ajinge tso maa nan bee shima je.

tiv_text: Iywa i í sôôn u kpen i kera ongo myel u orywa ga.
english_translation: A dog that wishes to die does not respond to its master's call.
deeper_meaning: Tiv 300 u tesen er or u alu u saan ishe yô, kera ongo kwaghwan ga. Ka nan norom sha kwagh bo. Nan ongo icintan kpaa ga.

tiv_text: Ka we a gbongor ityogh,iywa you kpa i gbehe u. Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er ka we a gba ican kwase wou kpa anyiman we. Shie gen u za ii nahan teru shin ngôu kpa un a nyiman er un fa u ga.
english_translation: Once you shave your head, even your dog can bark at you.

tiv_text: Mba gberen akpa mba gbidi ishegh taav man i bughun ga, ka i lu ihyôwe.
english_translation: A snuffbox is not opened by striking it with a cane; it is opened with a finger.
deeper_meaning: Zum u mba mankuretaav ka ve a soo u bughun Ishegh yô, ka ve kema ihyowe sha kughur na la tsetse sha er taav la, un a lu sha kur na kpa un a hide a kohol shimi yô. Tiv mba er kwagh ne sha u kaan er ka u ôron kwagh sha agee shin sha utaha ve ior a ungwa ga. Shin ka u ôron gbem ve or ongo kwaghwan ga.

tiv_text: Ka u shin sha ambi gbem man i nyie igyôm ga, ka i mar a mar or nyian igyöm ken uya je.
english_translation: It is not how long you spend defecating that determines how big your stool will be. Some people are simply born to pass big stools.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne sha u kaan er, ka zer-ôron kwagh gbem ve or ongo ga. Ka injakwagh shon imôm ka ve kaa er "Iyö i nyom i saan ityogh her, manve or kee ga" ye.

tiv_text: Saa ava a icor shin jande cii man a kure kor ga.
english_translation: You do not have to bring the whole raffia palm out of the stream before you can finish weaving a rope.
deeper_meaning: Heen kpa Tiv mba kaan er saa hanma or nan a lam ver a kure lyam/kwkagh ga. Shin u zer lamen gbem ver ú va ôr itine kwagh ga.

tiv_text: Se mir ityogh se ver ashe sha a we, ka we u lu a atsem ye u mase gbongor.

deeper_meaning: Tiv ngise ve haa mngerem shin ityo cii ve i hondo ye. Shi iyange i hondo sha atsem. Atsem iyange a lu je er ka lezôr nahan kpa a gema a hor tsa kera i kôr wegh sha mi i hondon ityogh. Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er ve ver ishima ve sha or. Ka u geman iyol ve cii wan sha ikyev i or. Gbashima u nan cii ka sha a we, ka we u lu myima u nan ye.

tiv_text: Iji i ílu i ape kpen ga yô, i tem sha ishuugh
english_translation: A housefly that does not want to die always sit on a broom.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba hembe õron injakwagh ne u tesen iyol paregh. Ka we a soo wer kwagh a va tseru ga yo, u wa iyol sha iyolyou. Voogh er u soo wer Agina a va hen ya wou ga yô, ka u gber iwambe, we kua ya wou cii.

tiv_text: Mkange ikpya Shimbe zwa m kende shin mnger ve, tese se amborboso
english_translation: I tied the mouth of an aardvark-skin bag and dropped it into the stream. The one who is up will show the bubbles.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba hembe ôron injakwagh ne u pasen er, ve ve nôngo kwagh ne sha mnenge ve, kwagh un a shi yô orgen nan a mase kuren. Ka u tesen er nan fa bee ga, shin nan shar ve, orgen nan a mase kôngor.

tiv_text: Ka we a dugh ityôndo gbaaye u ngôôr zende ga. Ityondo gbaaye ka kon u ú ngôôr pirin usu ga yô.
english_translation: Whoever carries a burning stick of African mesquite does not waste time on the journey home.
deeper_meaning: Ka nahan man or ngu a za dugh hen anngbyan er nan a za keer yô nan yemen fele fele je er ua va pir. Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er, ka we a lu a mzeyol yo u lanen ayom ou ga. Hanma kwagh u a tseru yô u lanen cigh nagh ga

tiv_text: M kor bua sha akor we u ngu kamen atumba (Me kör bua sha akor we kam atumba).

deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwah ne u pasen er, orgen ngu yan ican, orgen ngu zuan a mtsera sha ican la. Shie gen or za kem kwase orgen ngu tsan amin. Kwase ugen ngu hulan sule kwase ugen ngu timen iyogh yan.

tiv_text: Aondo tsar wan la ashano ken ityő a nenge tar yem ca.

deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er kwagh ne sha u tesen er mfe u wan la ka u marami, ka sagh a tsaha wan la ye. Kwaghfan la ka Aôndo iyol Na a ne ye, ka or ga.

tiv_text: Bua u alu a tsa ga Aôndo hur un iji iyolna.

tiv_text: Se kpen m ese u Jembe se va gber mule.

tiv_text: Ka we a sôron ijua i kpen u ver ikyur ikyua.

tiv_text: Ka we a eren belanda u mkee u kera aan ityô ga.

tiv_text: Akor a ngô Ivyo nga nduur Kpev yav ga.

deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er inja kwagh ne u tesen er kwagh ka un a doo u ishima yô u nengen a iyolnyoon ga. Dooshima tesen avav ga. Dooshima hidi jime sha ican kpaa ga.

tiv_text: Mumu baver cii ve avie ga.

deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er, saa ior awa zwa sha kwagh cii man ve a kure ga. Shin saa ior ve a lu hen kwagh cica man a hii ilyam ga. Shin saa ior ve a fa kwagh hen ya cica man ya un a doo ga.

tiv_text: Ka hen ya u orcian-kwagh ka i zua a ikonogh ki teman ôron ijir i ortaver shima ye.

deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen mdoom ma ivolparegh. Ka u tesen liba i mhidi u iyol jime. Mba tesen er ka we a lu nomor yo, shiegen i va nande ya wou cica, ankwagh teman kpa i zua a mi u teman ga. Shiegen i tsee kpishi u teman a tema hen ya wou kpaa. Ka i lu hen ya u or palegh ivol ne i fatyô u teman lamen sha kwagh wou ye.

tiv_text: Mba burun tar sha ihyô i esen ga.

deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u pasen er doo u fankwagh been ga. Shiegen ka u nungwa ibumegh sha mi keng ve tar u doo ye. Shiegen u fa kwaghje kpa u de or wa u kwagh ve i doo ye.

tiv_text: Atsem u esen kpishi vihin kôngo utyo.
english_translation: A razor that is too sharp is likely to wound the scalp.
deeper_meaning: Heen kpa Tiv mba kaan er, kwaghfan-tsoron ka kwagh bo. Ka we a tese wer u fa kwagh tswen u va kar jindi kwagh. Tese er se fa kwagh kpa se hide a iyol jime, tar a hemba hômon.

tiv_text: Mtema toho vea or houbar inyam i bunde m keren ye.

deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen ndor wan u dedoo ga ka u va a ikyôrbo. Tese er ka we a dondo ya vea ormbaiv yo u zua a mtsera ga, shin shimavihin. Shi injakwagh la tese er ka we a ya ijende vea orfyer yô we kpa i henen er u ngu orfyer, nahan mtsera a bunden we u zuan a mi sha dondo wou la.

tiv_text: Wan ka nan a nder pepe, a nor ijua a tile hen iyue, ngô u fankwagh ka a tôô iyue sha.

deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne sha u tesen numkõron. Shi ka u tesen tsôngo shima u organden hen ya. Ka u tesen u tsengan nengen u organden ken hemen. Injakwagh ne tese er kwagh u organden nan nenge a mi wanye nan a lu sha kon kpa nan a nenge a mi ga.

tiv_text: Ukuma girinya je u tindi ishôm ye.

deeper_meaning: Girinya ka amar a ken Tiv, man saa iyange u lu ortavershima ve u vine girinya ye. Shi iyange i vinen amar ne sha ishôm. Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u kaan er u ngu a iyolwan sha hanma mtaver cii ve u hii kwagh ye. Saa u lu a agowan iyol sha mtaver u hanma kwagh ve u hii ye.

tiv_text: Kurugh fa Igbyanger i ityô na amen awen ye.

deeper_meaning: Tiv mba hembe õron injakwagh ne u pasen ishimataver. Ka u vande gbilen kwar a shima you cii ve u hii kwagh ye. Shi ka u tesen er or a vande nengen agee a nan man nan a hii kwagh ye.

tiv_text: Mtume idyu a ityô ga tsō m mena iwen yö ka taver ape karen.

deeper_meaning: Tiv mba hembe oron injakwagh ne er ka afanyő a vaan nahan. U tesen er or vande wan iyol sha zayol ga tso zayol va tser nan. Shi tese er mbamtaver mba ve va tser u la we a vande fan yô, ma u we iyol sha mi.

tiv_text: Mba undu mba til sha rwam man i ye ga, hide jime.
english_translation: You do not climb onto the food before you eat it. Step aside.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba hembe öron kwagh ne u wan kwagh. Sa u kporom u sosum ken kwagh ve u nenge ga U tile ken ca kpa u kure kwagh. U kaa a kaa imo tseegh kpa ia za kure kwagh. Saa u za iyol you ga

tiv_text: Iywa i tee kuhwe ka i tswam igen kpishi.

deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen ieren i orwanbo Ka or za kwagh keren ve a anngbyan nan a za zuan a mi yô nan gba tswamen anngbyan la. Ka pe iywa kpa ka i er je ra.

tiv_text: Ka iywa i i bende Adendem ahenga sha igyundu la ia vaa ahenga ye.

deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen ieren i oragee. Ka u pasen er or u nan lu a agee nan suen agee ga, ka nan lu viing ka or u nan va bam nan la nan a vaa iyol ye. Shi ka u tesen er ka mfe shio ka or za bam or u lun a tahav ye.

tiv_text: Ka iyo i nyom Kurugh anyi sha igyundu ia vaa anyi ye.

deeper_meaning: Injakwagh ne tese ishimataver. Ka u tesen er weu wa ikyo a ican ga, ka mba eren we ican la ve a mem ga ye. Shi ka u pasen wer, u vande taver ishima ka mba eren anger sha we la u zungu ve ve we u ngu a iyol i tseen sha kwagh môm môm ga.

tiv_text: Organden nana tema hen ityõatee, ivyo ia mar hen kor ga.
english_translation: An elder does not sit under a hut and allow a goat to give birth with a rope around its neck.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba hembe õron injakwagh ne u tesen ieren i sôron tar, shin u kôron num. Ka u tesen er doo u orkaven kwagh nan a lu ve tar ua gba gban nahan ga. Ka u tesen er ieren i organden ia lu kposo a i mbayev. Tiv mba er kwagh ne zum u organden ka nan a er ieren i bee i mbayev yô. Zum u kwagh a lu zan u vihin man organden nan we zwa ga yô, injakwagh ne ka i kuma sha mi tsembelee.

tiv_text: Wan ua ker ter na a ver sha tyo er un a ta nya yô, ake a ter na ka a pir un ashe a nenge a inya ga.

deeper_meaning: Mba er injakwagh ne u wan mbayev kwagh sha u civir uter vev. Ka u tesen tahav mbu orvesen shin teru a lu a mi sha mbayev yô. Ka u pasen tahav man kwaghfan u organden a hembe u mbayev yô. Shi ka u pasen er alu wan shin wanye ngu a icihi sha ter yô, ikyôr ia lagh nan ga shin nan a nenge a mzehemen ga.

tiv_text: Mba kaan a igyanden or er "kar sha mnyi kera" ga.

deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u pasen er saa a wa orkaven-ishigh kwagh sha aeren a cuku ga Organden ka nan fa kwagh u nan a er hanma shie u kwagh a tser nan yô.

tiv_text: Ka we a yesen Anyam wan uye atuul ga.

deeper_meaning: Injakwagh ne tese mdoom ma dondo. Shin u dondon vea or u na lu a kwagh ave yô. Anyam ka inyamkyume i eren ikyōr kpishi, tese er a lu or nana lu yesen Anyam wan yên nan a yaan inyam hanma shie. Tese er a lu u ngu ijende vea ornyar yó inyaregh ki a ban u ga.

tiv_text: Kwase u fankwagh ka un a tema tswen kpa a wa ikyondo anam, saa nomso ve a lu ga.

deeper_meaning: Tiv mba ôron injakwagh ne u tesen iyol-kôron-tsaha. Tese er or a vande sõron ya u nan cii ve vanya un a va ye. Ka u tesen er, we u vande karen iyol sha hanma kwagh cii ve u gba ami tembe ye. Ka u vanden lun a ago a wan iyol sha er kwagh un a bur u a bur ga yô.

deeper_meaning: Ngun ka u kaan er ka we a ya ikyar vea or nana zua a kwagh we kpa kwagh a ban u ga. Ka a er a or dedoo wea lu ikyua we kpaa erdoo la a bende a we. Ka injakwagh ne imiôm Tiv ka ve kaa er "mba a kar a ku hen we, u haa mlyam ashe ye".

tiv_text: Nor ngu ken toho kpa a yange mbahyev zende ga.
english_translation: The elephant may be in the bush, yet it does not stop the rats from roaming.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u pasen er mlu wou a de yinan we ga. Tese er or nan a lu a inyaregh kpishi, we a lu ami a kuma ga kpa, ishima i de yen u ga

tiv_text: Ka we a dughun iginogyo u kera kor llyó ga. Mba hembe dron injakwagh ne u tesen ghashim sha hanma kwagh u usoo u eren yo. Tese er ka w a na ishima u eren kwagh yo u kera zungu lyo vihin shin kunya ga. Shin ityuhwanev kpa u kone ongo ga shin anger man ilyahan ga.
english_translation: When performing acrobatics, you no longer worry about your buttocks.

deeper_meaning: Condemns immoral means of livelihood.

tiv_text: Ave tema gbirin aa tswar.
english_translation: Idle hands will scratch the buttocks.
deeper_meaning: Idleness leads to undesirable behavior.

tiv_text: Ka wea dugh igyôônôgyô u kur ityô ga.
english_translation: When you somersault, you do not protect your buttocks.
deeper_meaning: If something is worth doing, commit fully without distraction.

tiv_text: Nomsoor ka ake ga
english_translation: Manliness is not having a scrotum; it is courage.
deeper_meaning: True masculinity is defined by bravery, not biology.

tiv_text: Mimi hemba tungu
english_translation: Honesty is better than collateral
deeper_meaning: Integrity is more valuable than material security.

tiv_text: Kon mom ngu hingir ikyo ga
english_translation: One tree does not make a forest.
deeper_meaning: Success and strength come through unity.

tiv_text: Mfega wa hemba ime
english_translation: Ignorance is darker than darkness.
deeper_meaning: Lack of knowledge is more dangerous than physical darkness.

tiv_text: Tsa sha won ban ikyundu ga
english_translation: Long life leads to wealth
deeper_meaning: Patience and longevity create opportunities for success.

tiv_text: Ishimawan ine mkom
english_translation: Patience brings contentment.
deeper_meaning: Endurance leads to satisfaction.

tiv_text: Mbakoon kon omboo ga
english_translation: A dry tree cannot be ben
deeper_meaning: It is difficult to change someone who is already set in their ways.

tiv_text: Uwaa sen tswen hure
english_translation: A stream flowing alone has many bends.
deeper_meaning: Lack of support makes life more difficult.

tiv_text: Kpev yar ikyoo gema koso iyongo ga
english_translation: A male goat looks for food, not to feed a sheep
deeper_meaning: People primarily act in their own interest.

tiv_text: Atseree wua alom
english_translation: Trickery killed the hare.
deeper_meaning: Deception leads to downfall.

tiv_text: Uya gege uya ihoon ve
english_translation: You have eaten until you ate a rotten one
deeper_meaning: Excess leads to negative consequences.

tiv_text: Orpinen tsum ga
english_translation: He who asks gets it right.
deeper_meaning: Asking questions leads to understanding.

tiv_text: Or fe iyange itondon igbum ga
english_translation: No one knows when a stone may wound their toe
deeper_meaning: Life is unpredictable.

tiv_text: Wanye kpa kaa er ikpera iyar tior
english_translation: Even a child can suggest how to drag a buffalo.
deeper_meaning: Wisdom can come from anyone.

tiv_text: Aondo nyiaa, atii due
english_translation: When God flashes, hidden things are revealed.
deeper_meaning: Truth will eventually come to light.

tiv_text: Iti idedoo hemba tungu
english_translation: A good name is better than wealth
deeper_meaning: Reputation is more valuable than riches.

tiv_text: Hiar ka a hiin i hiin a igbe.
english_translation: As soon as the whirlwind starts, one starts swearing by the igbe cult emblem.
deeper_meaning: Conflict should be stopped early before it grows beyond control.

tiv_text: Iyongo i hiin a ahan zwa.
english_translation: Trouble usually starts with laughter.
deeper_meaning: A joke or insult that looks small can grow into serious conflict.

tiv_text: Ka a teen we u kpeen ishe.
english_translation: When you are being sold out, your mar or influence the bargain.
deeper_meaning: Once you discover a harmful plan against you, act quickly to stop it.

tiv_text: Anyi vea nombor je kpa mba zehe.
english_translation: Even the teeth and the tongue do quarrel sometimes.
deeper_meaning: Conflict can happen even between close people.

tiv_text: Ivo i nyiman ga kpa ka wea zer a i gbem yô i nyima.
english_translation: A goat does not bite but when you maltreat it ceaselessly, it bites.
deeper_meaning: Even a peaceful person may react when pushed too far.

tiv_text: Ka a kperan ikpa i ande.
english_translation: When two people struggle over a bag, it gets torn.
deeper_meaning: Endless struggle damages what both sides are fighting over.

tiv_text: Kwagh kur sha ayem ga.
english_translation: Running away cannot bring a matter to an end.
deeper_meaning: Problems should be faced and resolved, not avoided.

tiv_text: Alu u kur a ishima i ker ityev u lôhô angbian ruam ga.
english_translation: If you consider the stress on the farm, you will not invite a brother to eat your food.
deeper_meaning: No matter how much you suffered to gain wealth or success, you should still care about others and not become selfish.

tiv_text: Kpera keera me tema ka ingyohol ga.
english_translation: Shift a bit let me also sit does not entail taking over one's seat.
deeper_meaning: Sharing with someone does not mean losing your ownership.

tiv_text: Ka a zaan a za i zaan sha ijô angahar; a geman hiden i hiden a ivaa zwa.
english_translation: People tiptoe while going on a deal but on their way back wailings are heard.
deeper_meaning: Secret bad deals often become public when they fail.

tiv_text: Kwagh tse a tsa, kwagh saan ga.
english_translation: Something may last long but shall surely be over some day.
deeper_meaning: No conflict lasts forever.

tiv_text: Ka hen ya u orcian-kwagh ka i zua a ikyônogh ki teman ôron ijir i ortavershima ye.
english_translation: It is in a weak man's house that they find a chair to sit and judge a strong man's case.
deeper_meaning: Excessive stubbornness or force can make people unite against someone.

tiv_text: Mba cirin ayem ikyondo ga.
english_translation: One does not cover up running in a cloth.
deeper_meaning: Let go of pride and allow peace to happen.

tiv_text: Tegh tegh hemba ayem.
english_translation: It’s better to take time to do something than to rush.

tiv_text: Kokombo per sha jime nor.
english_translation: You tag uno someone to get out of trouble or bad situations.

tiv_text: Mnenge hemba mtem.
english_translation: It’s better to try than to remain idle.

tiv_text: Tokwa u purugh hembe u nahan ga.
english_translation: You may lose some but gain more.

tiv_text: Ka wea gba mnger u mor iyav.
english_translation: One is into something and there is no going back—encouraging words.

tiv_text: Wua u wanye kpa nor ye.
english_translation: Listening to a child can help adults. Children have useful opinions, too.
deeper_meaning: An elephant even eats a child’s guinea corn.

tiv_text: Ahi nga hie orapirashe atsenge ahar ga. Similar: once beaten, twice shy.
english_translation: Don’t make the same mistake twice.

tiv_text: Yan sha ikughul.
english_translation: Very close relationship.

tiv_text: Nur akende.
english_translation: Display pride.

tiv_text: Nur igundu.
english_translation: Act with pride.

tiv_text: Ta nombol kor. Watch your tongue.
english_translation: Be careful what you say.

tiv_text: Wa zwa takema.
english_translation: Be careful how you speak or talk.

tiv_text: Mliam ashe.
english_translation: Show sadness.

tiv_text: Nduur iyol.
english_translation: Attempt to shake off unwanted acts one is surrounded with.

tiv_text: Ishange la mwem; ishange la mwem. Lit: flour is made by each grain producing flour.
english_translation: Success comes in bits.

tiv_text: Orkarenkwar ye ahenge.
english_translation: Avoid taking the best part if you tasked with sharing something.

tiv_text: Ka u gba sha nam u zua a mtemam ye.
english_translation: You think big even to get a little.

tiv_text: Haa mngerem sha usu.
english_translation: Quell the flaming issue.

tiv_text: U dondo orihundu u gba idyeregh.
english_translation: Don’t follow blindly.

tiv_text: Kôr ave sha kwagh.
english_translation: To unnecessarily cling on something.

tiv_text: Kema itiough.
english_translation: Putting people log ahead with each other.

tiv_text: Oruma ngu a memem ga.
english_translation: Life is full of obstacles.

tiv_text: Kerakekera kuma or ga.
english_translation: Being unsteady is not fitting for a person.

tiv_text: Yevese mnyim za gba sha usu.
english_translation: You are going from one problem into another.

tiv_text: Alabar tee gbough ga.
english_translation: News spread unhindered.

tiv_text: Wegh ku yanegh ka ku kile ku imese; ku imsegh di ku kile ku yan.
english_translation: Show mutual respect or look for and act on common grounds.
deeper_meaning: the right hand washes the left; the left washes the right.

tiv_text: Ka a vaan kpa iyaan.
english_translation: We need not remain unhappy all the time. Show some joy even when you are unhappy.

tiv_text: Kwambe har mindi ivambe ishe.
english_translation: Don’t make the same mistake twice.

tiv_text: Mhange hemben itiegh ki ishwagh.
english_translation: You can dip into your savings when it becomes necessary.

tiv_text: Ormaan ye atsenge.
english_translation: If you have much, you can live humbly.

tiv_text: Ya anyi.
english_translation: Be patient.

tiv_text: Ka we a meen inyam u tenge hondo ga.
english_translation: Behave well when seeking something good.

tiv_text: U kpe kpa u hire a inya ga; u ya ku injô ga.
english_translation: Death is certain.

tiv_text: Kwa tsa sha saa kpa hemba shin inya.
english_translation: Everything beginning has an ending.

tiv_text: Ikuleke via or anyishio.
english_translation: Inability to use the good thing that one has.

tiv_text: Ya gege ya ihi i hôôn.
english_translation: No one is absorbed from having issues or problems.

tiv_text: Vese ga ye iyol na ga.
english_translation: A little is better than none (or nothing).

tiv_text: Kukuku kur kwagh ga.
english_translation: Something does not end well with hesitations.

tiv_text: Ishan kwagh ker inya ga.
english_translation: Expressing good health. M ngu gbang gbang, di er Ishan kwagh i ker inya ga nahan. (I’m fine, just as a grain of something does not get dirty.)

tiv_text: Ishe sha ishe; inyigh sha inyigh.
english_translation: Paying one in kind.

tiv_text: Kwagh tsee iyol.
english_translation: The issue has become heated (difficult to resolve).

tiv_text: U zendan orihundu ideregh.
english_translation: Following another’s bad/improper ways.
deeper_meaning: running after a mad person without clothes on you.

tiv_text: Abanyam kar a kar zende kpa ihuma bee ga.
english_translation: Even small acts of goodness bring rewards.

tiv_text: Aluer abanyam a kpe yô, or a kera tema hen ya la ga a kuma inyom.
english_translation: The rewards of much goodness are immeasurable.

tiv_text: Ka naha wen.
english_translation: It’s your turn to act.

tiv_text: Wanye u tsough tso tsough ye tsa iviha.
english_translation: One is mightily rewarded by acting fast.

tiv_text: De de ka cigh.
english_translation: Obeying calls to avoid unwanted behaviour is healthful.
deeper_meaning: saying “stop, stop” is medicine.

tiv_text: Kende ave sha.
english_translation: To surrender.

tiv_text: Tuur or ke(n) ityô.
english_translation: To persuade someone to act where they would otherwise not do.

tiv_text: Doo iyol ga.
english_translation: Not feeling well.

tiv_text: Vihi iyol.
english_translation: General state of unwellness or inability to accomplish.

tiv_text: U za kasua ga tsô u fe we a yara?
english_translation: Equivalent meaning: How would you understand if you have not learned?

tiv_text: Tume toho a kwagh.
english_translation: To engage in pointless pursuit or reasoning.

tiv_text: Tôndo itiough na Udam.
english_translation: To rage with anger.

tiv_text: Zer gbem hemba ikpagher.
english_translation: Persistence pays (i.e., is better than a good luck charm).

tiv_text: Ican woo or ga.
english_translation: You can manage poverty or lack of money or things.
deeper_meaning: Poverty does not kill.

tiv_text: Kwagh ka a hiin i hiin a min.
english_translation: Tackle issues right at the beginning.

tiv_text: Bugh ken mtu cir ken igongu.
english_translation: exchange one thing with another.

tiv_text: Ikyanden bua hemba ivo i kehen.
english_translation: a little is better than nothing. (No gift is too small.)

tiv_text: Wagh sen tswen hule.
english_translation: A better decision is made in consultation with another (others). (Two heads are better than one)
deeper_meaning: A river meanders because it flows alone.

tiv_text: Ka we a tsemben orapirashe iyou ú tungwan hondo.
english_translation: You whistle while peeling yam for a blind man.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne sha u tesen ikyav i mimi man perapera. A lu er u ngu tsemben iyou man tungwan hondo yô tese er we u ngu yan ga. Man er i lu iyou ki orapirashe yô, maa nan a na jighjigh je er we u ngu a kwagh ken zwa ga. Shi u ngu bumen nan ga. Ka we a eren kwagh a or u nan fe ga yô, u eren waang sha er nan a hen er we u ngu nzughul a nan ga yô.

tiv_text: Ka we a wuhwan orapirashe iyol u lu nan jingi.
english_translation: When you are dressing a blind man, you are his mirror.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen u sõron anngbyan jime. Zum u anngbyan alu nengen kwagh u u lu eren sha ci na ga la, ka u er sha mimi.

tiv_text: Ka we a zendan orapirashe hen ya wou yo, u kende nan aga ken won.
english_translation: When you are sending a blind man out of your house, first throw out his walking stick.
deeper_meaning: Zum u u kaa a orapirashe wer nan a due hen ya wou sha man u tee gbogh ku nan u kende ken won je, maa ka nan fa er kuma sha mimi ve. Tiv mba er injakwagh ne sha u tesen er, i ôron i luun a ieren sha min.

tiv_text: Mngerem ma acivin ma hie ya ga.
english_translation: Hot water does not burn a house.
deeper_meaning: Insults alone should not push a person into violent reaction.

tiv_text: Ishima i waan i ne mkom.
english_translation: Patience brings about satisfaction.
deeper_meaning: Patience helps people overcome conflict well.

tiv_text: Mba wuan icigh ki sôron bem mba we mkem sha mi ga.
english_translation: When they are grinding medicine for peace, they do not add pepper to it.
deeper_meaning: Peace talks should avoid hurtful words and blame.

tiv_text: Aluer iyongo i angbianev uhar ngi kuren ga yô, orvanya ka nan ya ve idyako.
english_translation: When two brothers fight without end, a stranger snatches their inheritance.
deeper_meaning: Long conflict destroys families and allows outsiders to benefit.

tiv_text: Indyer i tamenor ugen ka ia gba usu we di u mir i you.
english_translation: When the beard of another old man catches fire, you soak your own with water.
deeper_meaning: Learn from another person's trouble and take precaution before the same thing reaches you.

tiv_text: Ka a fa amar inyumun nga kera numun ga.
english_translation: When a plan to disrupt a dance festival is uncovered, precaution should be taken to foil the plot.
deeper_meaning: If the cause of an expected conflict is known, it should be handled early.

tiv_text: Ka wea eren belanda u mkee u kera aan ityô ga.
english_translation: When you are trading in pepper, you do not scratch your buttocks again.
deeper_meaning: Be careful in risky situations; your actions should match the reality around you.

tiv_text: Mngeren ma gbe human tsô ga, saa kwagh ngu a kpe shimin.
english_translation: Water does not just smell unless something dies inside it.
deeper_meaning: Every problem has a cause.

tiv_text: Ka akor a ou ka a mee iyese i ta u ye.
english_translation: It is a person's strong appetite for meat that causes the sting of a scorpion.
deeper_meaning: Desire or greed can lead someone into trouble.

tiv_text: Mumu baver cii ve a vie ga.
english_translation: It is not all corn that must pop before popcorn becomes edible.
deeper_meaning: Not everybody has to speak before an issue can be settled.
